title: The Leeward Monsoon
author: Ivo Brightwater
blurb: Odile Dravenmoor, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
